solutions.question: Which of the following diagrams represent functions and of which type? Fig (2): a diagram with left elements a, b, c and right elements 1, 3, 5, with arrows a → 1, b → 3 and c → 5.
steps: In Fig. (2), each element of the domain has exactly one image.
Different elements of the domain have different images, so the function is one-one.
Every element of the codomain is an image, so the function is onto.
Therefore, Fig. (2) represents a bijective function.
solutions.answer: Fig. (2) represents a function, which is a bijective function.

In a software house of a city with 300 software developers, a survey was conducted to determine which programming languages are liked more. The survey revealed the following statistics:
- 150 developers like Python.
- 130 developers like Java.
- 120 developers like PHP.
- 70 developers like both Python and Java.
- 60 developers like both Python and PHP.
- 50 developers like both Java and PHP.
- 40 developers like all three languages: Python, Java and PHP.

How many developers do not use any of these languages?
steps: Let P, J and H represent the sets of developers who like Python, Java and PHP, respectively.
n(P ∪ J ∪ H) = n(P) + n(J) + n(H) − n(P ∩ J) − n(P ∩ H) − n(J ∩ H) + n(P ∩ J ∩ H)
Number of developers who do not use any of these languages = 300 − n(P ∪ J ∪ H)
Number of developers who do not use any of these languages = 300 − 260 = 40
solutions.answer: 40 developers do not use any of these languages.
